method: Read-only verification of the 14 workbook code-violation rows: WebFetch on every workbook URL, WebSearch to locate replacements on the same official domain when a URL was dead, scrapfly_browser.py on WAF-blocked pages until Scrapfly throttled (429) mid-run, then WebFetch on the case-search portals themselves (Accela, EnerGov CSS, eTRAKiT, Socrata metadata JSON). No accounts created, no forms submitted, no Firecrawl, no src/scripts run.

Gotchas: DHCA housing code = rental/housing enforcement, while zoning/building code cases live in DPS Data DPS (open ASP.NET search, no login); the OCA citation set carries citation/department/status/amount but no address column in its schema, so it cannot be geocoded alone. Socrata HTML landing pages render as JS shells - read metadata from /api/views/<id>.json.
